Drawn path: v_ptr+8 = &FF, v_ptr+9 = the kind (TXA from X = ck_index,Y, the same value STX stored), as before. The kinds (compiled_bank5-7, hazel_a/b) write only (&C0),Y, (&C2),Y, &C2/&C3 and PLAYER_SAVE+n; compiled_call writes compiled_back and ROMSEL; none touches v_ptr (&C4/&C5), the arena or ACCCON, so the early stores hit the same bytes and survive. At .called A and Y are reloaded/dead (LDA v_ptr; LDY #1 later), C still the kind's carry-clear for ADC #11. Kind entry: Y differs (9 instead of the ck_index index), but every kind sets Y (LDY #&08 etc.) before any use and its unsafe exits (compiled_unsafe_N: SEC/RTS) and checks use only A. Refused path (carry set): returns with X, A (ds_n), C as before; Y differs (9 vs ck_index index, or vs whatever) but the callers do not read Y: generic does BIT dm_flip then draw_column.each LDY #1; SKY_MODE=0's .cached does LDA ds_n / kc_part -> kc_find (LDX first, no Y read) and kc_draw sets Y before use. The two dirty bytes v_ptr+8/+9: put_on reserved arena_top + MAX_BLOCK before draw_mover, and the compiled drawn path writes these same bytes, so they are in reserved room; generic (ds_clip = 0 on this path, so every non-empty column is visible) writes +8 (count-1, never &FF) and +9 (.raised) for its first non-empty column; a refused kind has non-empty rows, and if none were drawn the block end is v_ptr+8 so restore_block never reads them; kc_draw writes KC_MARK and the slot there. Nothing reads above arena_top without writing first. Interrupt: irq1_handler does not read the arena or ck_kind, and any ACCCON change it makes it must restore (the existing header and kind writes already rely on that). Stack depth unchanged on every exit. Cycles: -STX zp (3) -LDA zp (3) +TXA (2) = 4 a drawn execution (plus 1 when BEQ in_hazel is taken: 9D04->9D23 no longer crosses); bytes -2-2+1 = 3.
